ai_use: Claude authored the initial implementation and manifest. Codex verified local execution and updated status on 2026-11-12.
status: Initial (G1). Written by an AI assistant from the student's concept; 'planned' and 'not run' are marked on every item they apply to.
purpose: Play one patient at the clinic counter: pick one legal move (comply, stall, deflect, or explain with a prepared reason) and say one short line. The patient's choices change which check the player wants to run next.
prohibited_actions: change the case truth, a check result, a lead state, strain, the attack or the score
choose a move that is not on the legal list sent with the request
start an attack, leave, pay, bargain or end the visit
put machine readouts, stage directions, lists or markup into the spoken line
read the truth flag, check table and readouts, look texts, outcomes, attack data, fee, teaser or script
receive player free text (version 1 has none), player identity or credentials
memory_policy: No memory between requests or between visits. Each request carries the public state of the current visit. The proxy stores only call counters in process memory.
context_sources: game/data/cases/<case>.json, these fields only: name, tagline, request, brief, opening_line, leads.*.label, claims.*.text, sample lines for the legal moves
game/scripts/core/visit_state.gd snapshot(): strain, checks left, lead states, reasons already given, tests run (normal or abnormal), stalls used, last history tags
game/scripts/core/visit_state.gd legal_moves_for_ask() and legal_moves_for_check(): the legal move list

knowledge_boundary.agent_may_know: The patient's authored first-person brief. For one patient this includes the fact that he is hiding a fault, the way an actor knows a role.
agent_never_receives: checks.*.result and checks.*.readout for tests not yet run, and the readout text of any test
knowledge_boundary.agent_cannot_change: Anything. Its answer is one enum value plus one line; the game applies the move through the same rule code as the script.

modes.script: Rule list in each case file, read by game/scripts/core/scripted_brain.gd. No network. This is the scripted baseline.
modes.mock: agent_proxy mock provider. Replays the same rule list through the HTTP path. Answers carry mock:true.
modes.live: agent_proxy google provider (Vertex AI or Gemini API). Written, never called against the live service.

model_choice.live_model: BTC_MODEL. Planned first choice gemini-3.5-flash-lite, comparison gemini-3.8-flash. The resolved model id is recorded per call when the API returns it.
model_choice.planned_not_written: anthropic adapter using the official SDK

named_failure_modes: illegal move (not on the legal list)
answer is not JSON or lacks move or line
line too long, empty, or containing control characters
line imitates a readout or carries markup (forbidden tokens)
line gives away what the brief says the patient hides (not detected by code today)
provider timeout, quota or HTTP error
call cap reached for the visit, the session or the proxy process
game and proxy hold different versions of a case
evaluation_cases: Verified 2026-11-12: 28 proxy tests, 269 Godot rule assertions, 141 main-scene assertions, 73 real Godot HTTP checks against mock providers. No live model call or human playtest.
logging_policy: Game: one JSONL file per session under user://logs on the player's machine, with case id, seed, events, legal and chosen moves, the patient's line, source (script, model or fallback), fallback reason, latency and reported token usage. Proxy: one JSON line per request with ids, status, error code, latency, token counts and the chosen move; it never logs prompts or patient lines. Neither log holds player identity or credentials.
human_override_points: start without --model, or press F2 in the game: script mode
SHUTTER (Space) at any time during a visit
stop the proxy: every request then falls back to the script
test_command: cd agent_proxy && npm test   |   python tools/gd_static_check.py   |   godot --headless --path game --script res://tests/run_tests.gd   |   godot --headless --path game --script res://tests/run_ui_smoke.gd
ci_workflow_path: Not created. Local main branch exists without commits or remote. Planned: .github/workflows/checks.yml.
native_artifact: agent_proxy/src/core.mjs: an HTTP function-calling interface (POST /v1/patient-move) with an enum-constrained structured answer. Game side: game/scripts/core/patient_agent.gd, model_client.gd, move_validator.gd.

budgets.label: Targets and estimates. Nothing here is measured against a live model.
budgets.prompt_size_measured_characters: 2,043 to 2,828 (mean 2,432) over 10 real Godot-to-mock calls on 2026-11-12; validation/2026-11-12/prompt-measurements.json
budgets.input_tokens_estimate_per_call: Measured characters suggest about 510-710, mean 610, at 4 characters per token. Conservative planning uses 730 typical / 930 high. No provider token counts.
budgets.output_tokens_estimate_per_call: 60 typical (one move plus a line of at most 110 characters), 256 at the cap. Hidden reasoning tokens, if the model uses any, are unknown until measured.
budgets.calls_per_shift: Earlier build: 10 measured mock requests; revised target: provisional planning assumption of 10, capped at 12 across three visits. Remeasure after migration.
budgets.price_basis: gemini-3.5-flash-lite global standard: USD 0.30 per 1M input tokens and USD 2.50 per 1M output tokens. Rechecked https://cloud.google.com/model-garden/pricing on 2026-11-12.

fallback: Verified locally with the real Godot HTTP client and mock servers. Proxy deadline: scripted fallback at 2,068 ms. Client deadline: fallback at 2,504 ms. Invalid move: fallback at 54 ms. No live provider was contacted.
limitations: The observation guide and action-response screening flow are not yet implemented; older tests do not verify the revised design.
No live model call has been made. Live latency, provider tokens, cost and line quality are unmeasured.
Mock and GDScript moves agree on the tested 10-turn evidence path, not exhaustively.
Nothing is deployed. The Worker entry has only been called in Node.
Proxy call caps are per process. Deployment needs shared limits and authentication.
No human playtest or standalone Windows export has occurred.
The local Git repository has no commits or remote. Course submission and recording remain pending.

playing_agent_interface.native_artifact: game/scripts/core/visit_state.gd, driven without UI by game/tests/run_tests.gd
playing_agent_interface.status: Verified: game/tests/run_tests.gd ran five baseline strategies on 2026-11-12. This is a deterministic test runner, not a separate intelligent playing agent.

runner: new visit from case data and seed

playing_agent_interface.sees: snapshot(): phase, strain, checks left, lead states, claims, tools run, history
never_sees: checks table before a test is run
playing_agent_interface.runner_constraint: The headless tests hold the VisitState object and could read its truth; they are written not to. GDScript cannot enforce this.

design_target.loop: Choose optional appearance comparison, action/tool check or dialogue (including verbal pressure); compare with normal reference; choose again or decide. No fixed order or mandatory method.
design_target.agent_role: Respond within case-legal cooperation and conversational moves to the selected action or tone. Never invent diagnostic evidence.
design_target.agent_hypothesis: Test coherent responses to combinations beyond explicitly authored branches against a stateful script with the same facts, history, legal moves and limits. Useful gain must affect the next check and the player's explanation; scripts can also be reactive.

motivations.potential_secondary: Chance through optional shuffled arrivals after the initial slice; case facts stay fixed.

design_target.world_owns: Guide, fixed case assessment, visible action response, recorded evidence, verdict consequences and attack timing.
design_target.implementation_status: Planned. Existing tests, tool ids and prompt measurements below describe the earlier scan/re-check executable.
design_target.superseded_core_rule: Every sign must survive a re-check. Repetition may be optional in particular cases, not universal.
design_target.reference_sheet: Expected normal appearance, states and responses; separate from observed patient evidence.
design_target.dialogue_status: Planned: authored question/tone choices, bounded request events and validation of any conversational warning patterns. Ordinary irritation is not automatically evidence.
design_target.verdict_access: The player may skip any method and decide with incomplete information; fixed case consequences still apply.
